title: Banning Free Plastic Bags
passage: Six people have answered a study about banning stores from giving customers free plastic bags. You should always bring your own bag with you to the supermarket. If not, you can either borrow one or just buy one. It's the least you can do. Paper bags break easily when carrying heavy items, and they get wet in the rain. This is great! Those thin plastic bags that stores give you for free are bad for the earth. This will reduce the total amount of plastic that ends up in the ocean. I think it's a stupid idea. I don't want to have to pay one or two dollars for a bag just because I forgot mine. This doesn't excuse big companies which do nothing to protect the environment. I'm not used to bringing bags to the store with me, so I would probably forget to bring a bag quite often. It could cost me a lot of money to keep buying new ones. I agree. The government should make stores sell bags and also remind people to bring one or two bags with them.

reading_questions.question: What change does the study ask people about?
choices: Stopping stores from giving customers free plastic bags
Closing supermarkets on rainy days
Replacing every plastic bag with a paper box
Making customers buy food online
reading_questions.explanation: The study asks about banning stores from giving customers free plastic bags.

reading_questions.question: What problem with paper bags does one person mention?
choices: They cost too much to make
They break with heavy items and get wet
They are harmful to the ocean
They are too small for groceries
reading_questions.explanation: The person says paper bags break easily with heavy items and get wet in the rain.

reading_questions.question: Why does one person support the change?
choices: It makes supermarkets richer
It protects large companies
It can reduce plastic entering the ocean
It makes paper bags stronger
reading_questions.explanation: The supporter says fewer free plastic bags will reduce plastic that ends up in the ocean.

reading_questions.question: Why might another person spend a lot on bags?

The person buys too many groceries
The government charges a fee
The person may often forget to bring a bag
reading_questions.explanation: The person is not used to bringing bags and might repeatedly buy new ones.

reading_questions.question: What does the final speaker think the government should do?

Give every customer two free bags
Ban supermarkets from selling bags
Make companies use only paper bags
reading_questions.explanation: The final speaker supports selling bags and reminding people to bring reusable bags.
